items.heading: Hummus
details: Key ingredients: chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, cumin
Blend cooked chickpeas with tahini, garlic and lemon juice until smooth.
Add cold water gradually to reach a creamy consistency.
Season with cumin and salt to taste.
Spread onto a plate, swirl with olive oil and serve with pita.

items.heading: Tabbouleh
details: Key ingredients: bulgur wheat, parsley, mint, tomato, lemon juice, olive oil
Soak bulgur briefly in water until softened, then drain well.
Finely chop large amounts of parsley, mint and tomato.
Toss everything with the bulgur, lemon juice and olive oil.
Chill briefly before serving as a refreshing salad.

items.heading: Chicken Shawarma
details: Key ingredients: chicken thighs, yogurt, garlic, shawarma spice blend, lemon
Marinate chicken in yogurt, garlic, lemon juice and spices for several hours.
Roast or pan-sear until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Slice thinly against the grain.
Serve wrapped in flatbread with garlic sauce and pickles.

items.heading: Kibbeh
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
